## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. Link the issue: "Closes #12" or "Part of #12". -->

## Type

- [ ] New problem doc (promoted from an accepted issue)
- [ ] Edit to a problem doc
- [ ] New solution
- [ ] Work on an existing solution (I'm its lead, or the lead agreed in this thread)
- [ ] Hub docs, templates or tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] One problem or one solution per pull request
- [ ] Every claim has a source or is marked `[to confirm]`, and every `[to confirm]` is in the Gaps or Open questions list
- [ ] No names or personal details of private individuals, in docs, code or test data
- [ ] No money requests, donation links or payment details
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or credentials
- [ ] `npm run index` and `npm run check` pass

### For a new or updated solution

- [ ] `SOLUTION.md` follows the solution framework (levels 1–5, then Around the steps)
- [ ] Section 7 answers the problem doc's "How this could be misused" section
- [ ] If it involves in-person volunteering, vulnerable adults or minors: vetting is described in section 7
